summary: Turns each bug or idea email sent to the NovaDesk support inbox into a clear ticket for the dev team in the Jira project NOVA, and never creates a duplicate. AI decides the type, product, priority and label from how you handled similar emails in screenpipe, and rewrites the email as a summary, steps to reproduce, expected result and impact; when it is not sure, nothing is created and screenpipe sends you a "Sort by hand" notification. Nothing runs until you turn it on.
